raw.rationale: PSI-6130 is a cytidine nucleoside prodrug of the HCV NS5B polymerase inhibitor R7128 (mericitabine), and its active triphosphate is a chain terminator for viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerases with no known activity against human DNA/RNA polymerases at low micromolar concentrations; PRISM screens of such antiviral nucleosides typically show no lineage-selective cytotoxicity. Therefore selective killing of any lineage at 2.5 µM is very unlikely, consistent with the low base rate.
